title: Chapter 8: True Love and the Prince Awakened
chineseTitle: 第 8 章：真爱解除诅咒与王子重现（终极幸福）

paragraphs.en: Beauty awoke the next morning in her father's cottage. When her father entered the room and found his daughter healthy, radiant, and richly attired, he wept with overwhelming joy, embracing her again and again. Beauty showed him a magic trunk that had arrived with her, filled with precious jewels and gold coins sent by the generous Beast to restore her father's fortune.
paragraphs.zh: 贝儿第二天早上在父亲的农舍里醒来。当她父亲进入房间发现他的女儿健康、容光焕发且穿着华丽时，他流下了无尽喜悦的眼泪，一次又一次地拥抱她。贝儿向他展示了一个随她一起到达的魔法箱，里面装满了慷慨野兽寄来的宝贵珠宝与金币，用以恢复她父亲的财富。

paragraphs.en: Her two jealous sisters, burning with envy, plotted to keep her beyond the seven days so the Beast would devour her in anger. Touched by their fake tears, Beauty stayed longer. But on the tenth night, she dreamed she saw the Beast lying unconscious near the rose bower, dying of grief! Horror struck her heart: 'How cruel I am to hurt the one who has shown me boundless devotion!'
paragraphs.zh: 她的两个嫉妒的姐姐因嫉妒而发狂，策划把她留到七天以上，以便野兽在愤怒中吞噬她。被她们假的眼泪所打动，贝儿多留了几天。但在第十天晚上，她梦见野兽昏迷地躺在玫瑰凉亭附近，因悲伤而濒死！恐怖击中了她的心灵：“我是多么残酷去伤害一个对我展现无尽奉献的人！”

paragraphs.en: Beauty immediately placed the gold magic ring on her table and fell asleep. Waking back in the magic castle, she ran into the garden and found the Beast motionless near the rose bower. Throwing herself upon him, she wept bitterly: 'Oh Beast, live! Live to be my husband! I love you with all my soul!' The air blazed with radiant light and music! The Beast vanished, and in his place stood a handsome Prince, who thanked her for breaking the spell. They were married in triumph, living happily ever after.
paragraphs.zh: 贝儿立刻将金色的魔法戒指放在她的桌子上睡着了。在魔法城堡醒来，她跑进花园发现野兽倒在玫瑰凉亭附近动也不动。扑倒在他身上，她号啕大哭：“哦野兽，活下来！活下来做我的妻子吧！我全心全意爱着你！”空气中放出了绚丽的光芒与音乐！野兽消失了，取而代之的是一位英俊的王子，感谢她打破了咒语。他们在胜利中结婚了，从此幸福地生活在一起。
